_why: Units whose vdata has no m_sLocUnitName are still named by the game elsewhere: the kill feed and the attacker-class strings of the same localization ('titan_unit' = Patron, 'Citadel_AttackerClass_CLASS_TROOPER_MEDIC' = Medic Trooper, 'Citadel_Hud_KillFeedSuperNeutral' = the Mid Boss). Rules are regexes on the unit id -> a localization key, first match wins; m_sLocUnitName always wins over a rule. Units the game never names keep a readable form of their id on the site (common.pretty_id), never the raw id.
_why_2026_10_01: audit: the Mid Boss reads 'Mid-Boss' (objective_midboss) rather than the kill feed's 'MidBoss'; the Shrine (destroyable_building) is 'shrine_unit'; McGinnis' turret unit takes its ability's name 'Mini Turret'
